generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to close its fingers around the Rubik's cube on the light blue plate, lift it clear, and carry it toward the teal plate. It lowers the cube onto the teal plate and opens its fingers around it, ending with the hand still close to the cube. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: The light blue plate is empty. The cube is positioned on the teal plate, with the right fingers opening and the hand still close around its upper/side region. The left hand remains open and clear. Full hand withdrawal is not shown.

arm_hand_roles.right: Sole manipulating hand: reaches, closes fingers and thumb around cube, lifts, transports to teal plate, lowers, and begins opening at the end.
arm_hand_roles.left: Open and largely stationary beside the basket; does not grasp, stabilize, support, or receive the cube.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation; no hand-to-hand transfer or supporting contact.

uncertainties: The right thumb overlaps the cube in the final view; complete loss of all hand contact and a stable hands-clear resting state cannot be confirmed. The prompt therefore describes lowering onto the plate and visible finger opening, without claiming a completed withdrawal.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
